title: 第8章 风城往事八第九章 风城往事九
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
苏家。
等到苏桃儿醒来，已经是晚上了。
“哥，我渴。”苏桃儿睁开眼，眼中恢复了往日的清纯。
“桃儿，你醒了。”苏少卿睁开朦胧的睡眼。
“等会儿啊，我去给你倒水。”苏少卿打起精神，起身来到桌前倒水。
“来，给。”苏少卿把水递给苏桃儿。
苏桃儿哪里管那么多，拿过水就咕咚咕咚的喝。
“慢点喝，小心呛着。”苏少卿道。
话音刚落，苏桃儿就被水呛了，喷出一大口水来，不偏不倚，正中苏少卿。
“你看，让你慢点喝，不听话。”苏少卿也不恼，把水杯拿过来，轻轻的拍着苏桃儿的后背。
不一会，苏桃儿缓过来。
“好点了吗，身体有不舒服的地方吗。”苏少卿问道。
“没，就是头有点昏。”苏桃儿摇了摇头。
“哥，我怎么了。”苏桃儿问道。
“你，你不知道吗。”苏少卿有些疑惑，一般觉醒的时候，觉醒者是可以感受到自己在干什么的。
“我就记得我在那个柱子前坐下，然后我一闭上眼，就什么都不知道了。”苏桃儿道。
“桃儿，你试着感受一下体内有没有一股其他的东西，是以前从未有过的，就像这个。”苏少卿把手掌摊开，一条火红色的武气出现。
苏桃儿仔细的感受着，半晌，摇了摇头。
“哥，我好像没有感觉有什么不一样的地方。”苏桃儿道。
苏少卿见状，收起武气，低下了头。

“哥，今天我不是觉醒了吗，我觉醒了几条经脉啊？”苏桃儿问道。
“这……”苏少卿不知道该怎么回答。
“少卿，桃儿醒了吗。”
外面传来何倩的声音。
“娘，桃儿醒了。”苏少卿连忙回答道。
何倩推门走进来。
“桃儿，怎么样，有没有不舒服。”何倩走过来道。
“没有，娘。”苏桃儿道。
“没事就是最大的万幸了。”何倩拍了拍苏少卿道。
“嗯。”苏少卿点了点头。
“娘，怎么了，哥哥为什么这个样子。”苏桃儿道。
“桃儿，你今天觉醒了经脉，只可惜你一条都没有。”何倩摸了摸苏桃儿的头。
“啊？为什么。”苏桃儿有点失望道。
“没关系，这个世界上没有经脉的人很多，就像娘，娘也没有经脉啊。”何倩道。
“啊，娘也像桃儿一样没有经脉啊。”苏桃儿有些惊讶道。
“对呀，可娘不也一样活的很好吗。”何倩道。
“嗯，我知道了，娘。”苏桃儿点了点头。
“只是可惜了。”苏桃儿道。
“可惜什么。”苏少卿道。
“可惜我以后就不能像哥哥保护我一样的保护哥哥了。”苏桃儿道。

苏少卿没想到她会这么说，心中一股暖流通过。
“傻孩子，自古就只有哥哥保护妹妹，哪有妹妹保护哥哥的。”苏少卿笑着拍了拍苏桃儿的头。
“啊，娘，哥哥又打我。”苏桃儿抱着头假装哭道。
content_en:
Su family.
By the time Su Taoer woke up, it was already night.
"Brother, I'm thirsty." Su Taoer opened her eyes, and her eyes returned to their former purity.
"Tao'er, you're awake." Su Shaoqing opened her hazy sleepy eyes.
"Wait a minute, I'll get you some water." Su Shaoqing cheered up, stood up and came to the table to pour some water.
"Here, here." Su Shaoqing handed the water to Su Taoer.
Su Taoer didn't care so much. She took the water and drank it.
"Drink slowly, be careful not to choke." Su Shaoqing said.
As soon as she finished speaking, Su Taoer choked on the water and spit out a large amount of water, hitting Su Shaoqing squarely.
"Look, I asked you to drink slowly, if you don't obey me." Su Shaoqing was not annoyed, took the water glass over, and patted Su Taoer's back gently.
After a while, Su Taoer came over slowly.
"Are you feeling better? Do you feel any discomfort in your body?" Su Shaoqing asked.
"No, I'm just a little dizzy." Su Taoer shook her head.
"Brother, what's wrong with me?" Su Taoer asked.
"You, don't you know?" Su Shaoqing was a little confused. Generally, when awakening, the awakened person can feel what he is doing.
"I just remember sitting down in front of that pillar, and then as soon as I closed my eyes, I didn't know anything else." Su Taoer said.
"Taoer, try to feel if there is something else in your body that has never been seen before, just like this." Su Shaoqing spread his palms, and a fiery red martial aura appeared.
Su Taoer felt it carefully, and after a while, she shook her head.
"Brother, I don't seem to feel anything different." Su Taoer said.
Seeing this, Su Shaoqing put away his martial spirit and lowered his head.
"Brother, didn't I awaken today? How many meridians did I awaken?" Su Taoer asked.
"This..." Su Shaoqing didn't know how to answer.
"Shaoqing, is Tao'er awake?"
He Qian's voice came from outside.
"Mom, Tao'er is awake." Su Shaoqing quickly replied.
He Qian opened the door and walked in.
"Tao'er, how are you? Are you feeling uncomfortable?" He Qian came over and said.
"No, mother." Su Taoer said.
"It's the greatest luck that nothing happened." He Qian patted Su Shaoqing and said.
"Yeah." Su Shaoqing nodded.
"Mom, what's wrong? Why is brother like this?" Su Taoer said.
"Tao'er, you awakened your meridians today, but it's a pity that you don't have any." He Qian touched Su Tao'er's head.
"Ah? Why." Su Taoer said a little disappointed.
"It doesn't matter. There are many people in this world who don't have meridians, just like my mother. She doesn't have meridians either," He Qian said.
"Ah, mother has no meridians like Tao'er." Su Tao'er said in surprise.
"Yes, but isn't my mother also living a good life?" He Qian said.
"Yes, I understand, mother." Su Taoer nodded.
"It's just a pity." Su Taoer said.
"What a pity." Su Shaoqing said.
"It's a pity that I won't be able to protect my brother the same way he protects me." Su Taoer said.
Su Shaoqing didn't expect her to say that, and a warm current passed through her heart.
"Silly boy, since ancient times, only the elder brother protects the younger sister. How can the younger sister protect the elder brother." Su Shaoqing smiled and patted Su Taoer's head.
"Ah, mother, brother hit me again." Su Taoer pretended to cry, holding her head.
